part: STPM32 (STMicroelectronics), single-phase metrology IC, private UART frame protocol
interface: Direct UART to the metrology IC (CRC-8 framed, bit-reversed), ESP32 as bus master

measurands.name: voltage_v
measurands.accuracy: per STPM32 datasheet class; scale confirmed on 2026-08-24 against EnergyMeterSensor.c's actual packing (voltage_mV = round(V * 1000))

measurands.name: current_a
measurands.accuracy: per STPM32 datasheet class; scale confirmed on 2026-08-24 against EnergyMeterSensor.c's actual packing (current_mA = round(A * 1000), same convention as voltage, not a separately-scaled field)

measurands.name: power_w
measurands.accuracy: per STPM32 datasheet class; scale confirmed on 2026-08-24 against EnergyMeterSensor.c's actual packing (power_mW = activePower, already computed in milliwatts)

failure_modes: voltage and current both read exactly 0: STPM32 did not power up, or a gain/latch register write failed -- sensor_ok drops rather than advertising a plausible-looking zero
voltage pinned at exactly 230 V: firmware clamp, not a genuine reading -- treat any exact 230 as saturated, not as 'grid is perfectly regulated'
current stuck at 0 with sensor_ok=1: could be a genuine no-load condition, or the current channel isn't wired to a load -- this firmware does not currently distinguish those two cases
mounting: per RadioStudio hardware board (RS-P-00xxxxx); AC load wired per the STPM32 reference design
